photos.c: Opposite page. The Philips 100x1 mile relay. Top right: Charlie Gillett. Centre left to right: Dudley Gordon, Gerry Sexton, George Piddington and Robin Brown. Bottom left to right: Simon Pritchard, Joe McDonald and Alan Painter.
Some of the gang in the Boxing Day Fancy Dress Handicap. Top.L to R. Paul Richley, John Gladwin ,Alan Painter & Tony Grant. Centre. Bill Couzens, Bottom Leo Coy, Simon Pritchard and Peter Staples.

Gordon Biscoe appears to be looking at the watch in disbelief but it was a comfortable 58 at the bell for Richard O'Hara who ran out an easy winner. Alan Painter, a youngster of 39, was the only other runner inside 2 minutes. Pat Lyttle is still in touch at this point but his legs are about to part company with the rest of his body any second!
